```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue proposes improvements to the "Link Widget" used for adding internal and external links in Plone, aiming to enhance user experience and unify functionality across various components.

## What needs to be done
The main tasks involve defining the widget's final design, deciding what content appears by default (e.g., recent user-created content), and implementing features for saving, editing, and deleting links. It's also necessary to check for edge cases in these functionalities.

## Helpful background
This request stems from a common need in modern applications for easy link integration, as seen in tools like Google Drive and WordPress. The existing functionality can be enhanced to provide a more streamlined experience for users.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the current Link Widget components.
2. Review similar widgets in other applications for inspiration.
3. Engage in discussions with the team to clarify design preferences and feature requirements.
4. Be prepared for testing and documentation updates as part of the implementation.
5. Note that this work is still being discussed; the planning may shift depending on project priorities, especially with upcoming releases like Plone 6.2 or 6.3.
```
